Word, PowerPoint and Outlook insert into a new document, presentation or mail, or one that is open (the destination menu lists them). Excel inserts into the active sheet of an open or a new workbook. Outlook attaches the screenshot and uses the Email section's subject, To, CC and BCC; New Outlook can't be scripted. OneNote for Mac can't be scripted either: Notes takes its place (or use Open With). On a layout without a picture placeholder the screenshot is centred on the slide; a layout PowerPoint refuses gives a blank slide.
